rows.grounds: object or topic denoting the cakra
numeral forming first member of compound with patra
second member of compound indicating petals
adjective qualifying cakraṃ as having a central pericarp

items.question: What are the defining form and attributes of the sixth cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is identified in sequence.
It is described as royal in nature.
It has eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal, eight-petaled wheel possessing a central pericarp.
uncertainties: The precise referent of rājānam as a literal or honorific epithet is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is royal, having eight petals and a pericarp.
